props.title: Architectural epoxy & metallic concrete floors by
props.subtitle: Transforming dull concrete into showroom-grade, mirror-finish masterpieces. Specializing in decorative vinyl flake, custom metallic swirl, and high-traction quartz systems.

props.title: Precision Planetary Grinding and Extreme Adhesion Bonding
props.subtitle: We never cut corners on surface prep. Every slab is diamond ground and moisture barrier sealed before the first drop of epoxy touches the floor.

features.title: Vapor Barrier Base Coat
features.description: Houston's heavy coastal humidity pushes ground moisture up through concrete. Our deep-penetrating epoxy primer blocks up to 25 lbs of hydrostatic pressure.

features.title: Showroom Gloss Retention
features.description: Our dual polyaspartic clear coats resist tire burn, battery acid, motor oils, and harsh household chemicals without yellowing.

features.title: Seamless Turnkey Install
features.description: We repair all cracks, divots, and spalled control joints with polyurea menders before applying your chosen designer finish.

props.title: Designer Epoxy & High-Performance Polyaspartics
props.subtitle: Custom formulated for residential garages, aircraft hangars, commercial warehouses, and luxury retail.

services.title: Decorative Vinyl Flake Garage Floors
services.description: Heavy-duty multi-coat flake system offering superior traction, stain defense, and modern aesthetic elegance.

services.title: Exotic Metallic 3D Epoxy Systems
services.description: High-gloss metallic pigments swirled by hand into one-of-a-kind marble veining, lava flows, and pearlescent waves.

services.title: Solid Color Commercial Polyaspartic
services.description: Heavy industrial solid-color protection engineered for auto shops, machine rooms, and commercial manufacturing floors.

services.title: Exterior Patio & Driveway Coatings
services.description: Breathable, UV-stable decorative concrete coatings that withstand direct Gulf Coast tropical sun and driving rains.

services.title: Concrete Crack & Joint Restoration
services.description: Structural joint shaving and elastomeric polyurea filling to create completely flat, seamless floor planes.
